body:
> that's not a correct solution, make the types pass properly, all other tests pass typescript @copilot

Fixed in commits 59a61e0 and 465f185. The issue was that tsconfig.json was missing the `lib` compiler option, which TypeScript needs to recognize standard JavaScript APIs like `Array.prototype.find()`. Added `"lib": ["ES2020", "DOM"]` to provide these type definitions. The test file now properly type-checks with Jest types being automatically loaded from `@types/jest` when node\_modules is installed.
